title: Evaluation and scalar restriction preserve the specified clopen proper/open mate
statement:
Let $B$ be a commutative ring. For every scheme $X$ use its small pro-etale site with the chosen small skeleton, its constant ring sheaf $\underline B_X$, the abelian category of module sheaves, and $\mathcal T_X=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathbf N_{\geq1}^{op},\operatorname{Mod}(\underline B_X))$ of strict inverse systems. Work in the ordinary unbounded derived categories $D(\mathcal T_X)$. Use the termwise inverse image $G_u$, total derived termwise direct image $R_u$, and exact open extension $J_j$ with their specified adjunctions and compositors [def-cbc-strict-constant-tower-operations] [def-cbc-strict-tower-open-extension]. Let $Q$ be a commutative square of schemes with $k:V\hookrightarrow W$, $i:S\hookrightarrow T$ quasi-compact open immersions, $r:V\to S$, $p:W\to T$ proper, and $pk=ir$. Put $W_S=W\times_T S$ with projections $b:W_S\to W$, $q:W_S\to S$, and $s=(k,r):V\to W_S$. Let $\alpha_Q:G_pJ_i\to J_kG_r$ be the clopen arrow and let $\gamma_Q:J_iR_r\to R_pJ_k$ be its proper-adjunction mate [def-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-arrows] [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate], with formula
$$\gamma_Q=(R_pJ_k\varepsilon_r)\circ(R_p\alpha_QR_r)\circ(\eta_pJ_iR_r).$$
This natural transformation is defined in the strict-tower derived category by exact descent of alpha and the stated derived adjunctions. At every index $n$, exact evaluation commutes with $G_u,J_j$, and its direct-image comparison $\operatorname{ev}_nR_u\cong Ru_*\operatorname{ev}_n$ is the canonical K-injective resolution comparison. These comparisons preserve the derived adjunction units, counits and transposes; consequently $\operatorname{ev}_n\gamma_Q$ is the single-level proper mate of the same clopen projector, with the displayed unit-square-counit formula. For any ring homomorphism $B\to\Lambda$ of commutative rings, let $\operatorname{Res}_X:D(X_{proet},\Lambda)\to D(X_{proet},B)$ be restriction of scalars. The canonical inverse-image, direct-image and open-extension scalar comparisons identify the single-level $B$-mate on $\operatorname{Res}_VN$ with $\operatorname{Res}_T$ of the single-level $\Lambda$-mate on every $N\in D(V_{proet},\Lambda)$. Open extension and the projector keep their underlying sections and identity/zero maps under this identification. No flatness, scalar-restriction preservation of K-injectives, boundedness, or faithfulness on derived morphisms is assumed.

proof.text: By the definitions, $\alpha_Q$ is the exact descent of its termwise sheaf transformation. Its mate exists for the specified unbounded adjunctions. Substitute $L_1=G_r$, $R_1=R_r$, $L_2=G_p$, $R_2=R_p$, $G=J_i$, $H=J_k$ into the mate definition: the resulting arrow is precisely $\gamma_Q=(R_pJ_k\varepsilon_r)(R_p\alpha_QR_r)(\eta_pJ_iR_r)$. This construction takes place in the derived tower categories themselves.

proof.text: For the open unit, apply exact_mate to the termwise open adjunction and the ordinary open adjunction, with the two identity evaluation squares. Their ordinary unit equation is componentwise the same unit followed by an identity. The exactAdj_unit normalizations descend this equation to the specified derived adjunctions; evaluation_open_transpose follows by the Hom-equivalence formula and naturality. For alpha, use alpha_eq_localized_singleAlpha from the ordinary proper/open arrows node. Localization extensionality identifies the recorded alpha with exact descent of towerAlpha. Exact descent commutes with evaluation on arbitrary natural transformations, as follows from its representative equation and the functor composition factorization. This gives evaluation_alpha for the same singleAlpha, retaining all clopen projectors and compositors.

proof.text: Naturality of proEtaleConstantInverseImageMap gives coefficient_square directly. Specialize proEtaleRingSheafChangeAdjunction to these coefficient maps; its transpose clause is scalar_transpose. To prove scalarJInv_app_isIso and scalarJInv_isIso for arbitrary rings, paste the scalar-pullback square through the fixed-coefficient equivalences. The lower-shriek scalar model is invertible; inverse mates preserve the fixed equivalences, and cancellation of the equivalence edges yields invertibility of the specified scalarJInv. The proof uses the arbitrary-ring private helpers of FiniteOpenExchangeScalars and FiniteConstantCoefficientTransport; no Finite instance is used. proof.text: The open-unit characterization of $\beta^{-1}$ and Step 5 show that scalar restriction sends it to the $B$-comparison: their transposes are the same pulled-back open unit. The revised projector theorem identifies the adjunction-defined $\pi_s=(t_s s^{-1})^{-1}\eta_s$ with the first-factor section projection. Restriction retains these factors and the map $(x,y)\mapsto x$ (or $(x,y)\mapsto(x,0)$ after inclusion into both factors). Thus it preserves the specified $\pi_s$, not just an independently chosen projection with the same source and target. Thus the formula $\alpha_Q=(J_b\pi_sG_q)\beta_{i,p}$ is preserved, including its compositors: inverse-image composition is the canonical composition of the same pullback maps, and open composition is fixed by its iterated open unit. Finally write $t=J_k\varepsilon_r\circ\alpha_QR_r$. The transpose-preservation identity of Step 5, first for $r$ and then for $p$, identifies the restricted $\Lambda$-transpose of $t$ with the $B$-transpose on $\operatorname{Res}_VN$. This is precisely the asserted equality of the two $\gamma_Q$ maps after endpoint comparison, for every $N$. Only functoriality and the stated transpose identities were used; no cancellation by scalar restriction, preservation of K-injectives by it, flatness or cohomological bound enters. The scalar_projector equality may be checked after applying pullback along the clopen: the existing section-projector characterization turns it into the scalar open-unit equation and naturality. Equality after this pullback detects the original maps into extension by zero, by its isomorphism with direct image and adjunction transposition. In Lean, prove compatibility for beta, the projector, inverse-image composition, open composition and equality transport separately, then paste their equations in exactly the six-factor singleAlpha word. Open-composition compatibility follows by injectivity of the mate correspondence and inverse-image composition compatibility. Descend the ordinary equation with exactNat_square and exactSquare_comp_forward. Identify the scalar direct-image comparison with the mate of scalarG by scalar_transpose, and apply exchangeMate_cube to the descended alpha equation to obtain scalar_gamma.
